rationale: The plan correctly identifies the duplication as an expected property of non-UMI rRNA-depleted total RNA, refuses read-level deduplication, quantifies MT/rRNA/HB and top-N composition per sample, checks size factors against composition, and keeps sample_01 with a leave-one-out sensitivity refit rather than dropping it. The DESeq2 Wald model with ~condition, explicit control reference, median-of-ratios inside the model, BH at 0.05 and apeglm shrinkage all match the reference; the |LFC|>1 subset is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold, and the low-count filter gives the sample rule but not the count threshold. It does not state a policy for removing rRNA/MT genes from the matrix when their share is large and uneven, only a caveat. Enrichment was not asked but is done defensibly (Wald ranking, tested-gene universe, named collections, 15-500 window, seed), though collection versions and package versions are not required in the report.
